items.title: Russia's offensive ability is broken, Kyiv's former top general tells BBC
items.description: In his first interview since being forced from his post, Gen Syrskyi speaks about Ukraine's future in the war.

items.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
items.description: Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, starred as Walter White Jr in the Emmy-winning drama series.

items.title: One dead and several hurt after rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
items.description: Aerial footage at the park after the incident shows a stuck rollercoaster with riders being helped off.

items.title: Watch: Emergency calls from botched Christa Pike execution released
items.description: A series of calls, obtained by the Associated Press, reveal emergency services were delayed in reaching Pike.

items.title: Bulgaria summons Russian ambassador after ship sinks in Black Sea drone attack
items.description: Six crew members are rescued but 10 are missing after a merchant ship was sunk overnight, Bulgaria says.

items.title: Hungarian MPs scrap Orbán's anti-LGBTQ measures
items.description: LGBTQ and human rights activists warmly welcomed the move, but call for changes to other Orbán-era laws.

items.title: Super El Niño sets another record as it strengthens to 'unprecedented levels'
items.description: El Niño has continued to strengthen, with several key measures now in record territory. Simon King explores how it compares to previous events.

items.title: Ex-president named leader of new DR Congo rebel coalition
items.description: Joseph Kabila had previously denied having links to the M23 rebels, which control much of eastern DR Congo.

items.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
items.description: Despite the US president announcing energy infrastructure would not be targeted strikes have continued, Ukraine says.

items.title: India 'cockroach' leaders detained after entering barricaded protest site
items.description: Protesters climbed over barricades in central Delhi to demand the election chief resign over revised voter lists.

items.title: Watch: US man eyes pumpkin world record after fifth contest win
items.description: Horticulture teacher Travis Gienger hauled his pumpkin from Minnesota to Half Moon Bay, California where he won the annual event.

items.title: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
items.description: Shadrack Sibiya had denied grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old.
